source: F15-S01 route-inventory v2 + imboy源码鉴权链

chain_facts.middleware_order: cowboy_router -> cors -> security_headers -> auth_middleware -> feature_gate -> throttle -> cowboy_handler (imboy_app.erl:96-107)
chain_facts.tenant_fail_closed: 企业租户面即使误登记open()也不直通(auth_middleware_api_v1源码注释)
chain_facts.admin_auth: cookie adm_user_id + HMAC签名(adm_session_ds:issue/verify),RBAC=role_acl 6角色,权限可被config adm_role_permissions/adm_role_names覆盖

negative_design_mapping.MCP_CLIENT_CREDENTIAL: MCP client credential(mck);负例=无效mck fail-closed拒绝
negative_design_mapping.ANON_OPEN: open直通;负例=仅验证该路径免鉴权,邻近路径不得连带放行
negative_design_mapping.USER_JWT_SIGNATURE: JWT+设备签名;负例=无token=401/无效token=401/跨用户资源=403或404
negative_design_mapping.OPTION_LOGGEDOUT_WRITABLE: 免登录可写(option);负例=该类路径之外的可写操作无token应401
negative_design_mapping.ANON_OPEN_SIGNATURE: open但强制设备签名;负例=篡改/缺失签名应401(防重放)
negative_design_mapping.SITE_PUBLIC: 网站白名单;负例=非白名单站点路径应404
negative_design_mapping.STATIC_ASSET: 静态资产;负例=路径穿越(../)应拒绝
negative_design_mapping.ADMIN_COOKIE_RBAC: adm cookie+HMAC签名+RBAC;负例=无cookie或伪造签名=401;低角色访问高权限action=403无权限操作
negative_design_mapping.DYNAMIC_REVIEW: 动态拼装段;授权语义须运行时判定
negative_design_mapping.PAYMENT_CALLBACK_SIGN: 第三方支付回调签名验证;负例=错误签名拒绝;幂等=重复回调不重复入账

open_items: CS_SURFACE_REVIEW 路径的 credential/seat 二分须运行时按冻结函数复核
幂等负例的具体业务键(消息/支付/接单)须F15-S02用真实夹具验证
二次分类仅按前缀,CS credential/seat 的路径形状二分仍须运行时或读冻结函数复核
refinement_note: DYNAMIC_REVIEW 按路径前缀二次分类:/api/v1/cs/* -> CS_SURFACE_REVIEW,/api/v1/enterprise/* -> ENTERPRISE_TENANT_PRINCIPAL(依据 auth_middleware_api_v1 EB-04 注释:两前缀即租户面);其余动态段保留 DYNAMIC_REVIEW
